questions.stem: Which query returns total sales per region, only for regions whose total is over 1,000?

options.text: SELECT Region, SUM(Amount) FROM Sales GROUP BY Amount HAVING Region > 1000
SELECT Region, SUM(Amount) FROM Sales GROUP BY Region HAVING SUM(Amount) > 1000
SELECT Region, Amount FROM Sales GROUP BY Region, Amount HAVING Amount > 1000
SELECT Region, SUM(Amount) FROM Sales WHERE SUM(Amount) > 1000 GROUP BY Region

questions.explanation: WHERE filters rows before grouping and can't use an aggregate; HAVING filters groups after aggregation.

questions.stem: A column Email has some NULL values. Which two statements are true? Each correct answer is a complete solution.

options.text: COUNT(*) skips rows where any column is NULL
COUNT(DISTINCT Email) counts NULL as a distinct value
COUNT(*) counts every row, including rows where Email is NULL
COUNT(Email) counts NULLs as one extra value
COUNT(Email) counts only rows where Email isn't NULL

questions.explanation: COUNT(*) counts rows. COUNT(column) and COUNT(DISTINCT column) count non-NULL values only.
